description: Safe Crossing Project - Potentially unsafe pedestrian crossings in Luxembourg-City is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Zentrum fir Urban Gerechtegkeet. Project description - At a glance Safe Crossing is a project based on a crowd-sourced effort to assess if the setup of pedestrian crossings in Luxembourg-City Compline with the Code de la Route. Also, the project aimed at finding out whether Articles 164(2.)(e) & 166(h) of the Highway Code were complied with. Coverage: Zentrum fir Urban Gerechtegkeet. The publisher named on the listing is Zentrum fir Urban Gerechtegkeet. Its keywords include code-de-la-route, traffic, safety, luxembourg, pedestrian-crossing, mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by-sa. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
